name: theater-panel
description: Home theater wall panel: Plex browsing, Seerr requests, Music Assistant and room control, served to Kiosk Satellite.

scripts.push: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --provenance=false --sbom=false --build-arg BUILD_VERSION=$npm_package_version.$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --build-arg BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) --output type=image,name=ghcr.io/davidcoulson/theater-panel:latest,push=true,oci-mediatypes=false .
